[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Artifact-file index contract and query API in sase-core[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-index-contract[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-index-contract: extract the index parser into a tolerant [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]full-record module in the sase-core repo, accept envelope schema [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]versions 1..=2, add a filterable query function reusing plan-search date[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]parsing, and expose artifact_files_query plus a wire-schema handshake [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]through the PyO3 bindings.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Three record fields, tolerant reader, preserving writer, [/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]backfill library[/bold #D7AFFF]

    [#D7D7AF]subcommands — list through the new Rust query binding, show/path/open [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]and handler tests.[/#D7D7AF]
